trial_court: Judge, Family Court (North), Rohini, Delhi - M.T No.110/2015
case_name: Deepak Malhotra vs Deepti Malhotra & Ors.

parties.respondent_defendant: Deepti Malhotra & Ors., wife and others

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner was directed to pay Rs.22,000/- per month as interim maintenance to respondent from 23.07.2014 till disposal of the petition.

legal_principles.principle: When no definite evidence of income is offered, the Court has to form its opinion as to what could possibly be the income.
legal_principles.held: The guess work made by the Court below is without any basis and is based on wrong assumptions.

legal_principles.principle: The Court should not make assumptions about people not showing their real income for taxation purposes.
legal_principles.held: Such perception cannot be pressed into use while deciding any application judicially.

legal_principles.principle: The Court should consider all relevant documents, including rent agreements and receipts.
legal_principles.held: The Court below did not take into account the rent agreement and rent receipts which were filed by the petitioner.

outcome.final_order: The petitioner's appeal against the trial court order was allowed.
